about: The alleluia verse of the Second Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 121 — a song of pilgrims going up to Jerusalem. The joy comes not from arriving but from the word that they will go.

seg.tr: I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: we shall go into the house of the Lord.

fn.w003: Perfect participle of a deponent verb. With “sum” (w004) it forms one finite verb.
fn.w004: With “Lætátus” (w003), it forms the perfect of a deponent verb: I rejoiced.
